stage: prospective analysis rules for already examined v080 archives; NOT confirmatory preregistration
train_policy: Selected A calibration, all actual 200 ticks, separately by ecology
test_policy: Actual A/B/C 500-tick primary; same-policy A and cross-policy B/C reported separately

candidates.T1: Food/water at current tile or current nearest visible individual's tile, future END tick t+5; reference fixed at sequential pre-action t
candidates.T2: Food/water within Chebyshev radius 0/1/2 of frozen current position, future END tick t+1/5/10; radius0,h5 aliases T1 current, not counted twice
candidates.T3: At current tile future END tick t+5: depletion conditional present now, recovery conditional absent now, strict quantity increase/decrease using exact recorded integers
candidates.T4: Next actual food, water or either acquisition after current decision; own-opportunity time, death competing, administrative/gap censoring, no binary predictor
candidates.T5: Any actual food/water/either acquisition within next5 or10 own decisions, excluding current; positive observed event, negative only full alive follow-up, otherwise death competing/admin/gap missing

environmental_alignment: Only actual end-tick spatial snapshots may label t+h; absent snapshot is missing, never interpolated. Do not use future positions. Snapshot-aligned subset is a selected calendar population, not all decisions.
event_order: Consumption precedes death on a future terminal decision, so acquisition wins a same-opportunity tie. Death on origin is competing at elapsed0. No acquisition after a missing gap is linked across that gap.
eligibility: Per ecology/mode/seed; count, prevalence, actor, label coverage, conditional variation and M0/M1 common support must all pass. Memory additionally requires M0/M1/M2 common support and supported memory-token variation. A candidate qualifies for selection if at least one ecology passes all9 A/B/C seed cases. Environmental inference across calendar requires label coverage>=.5; sparse exact-snapshot subsets remain exploratory.

selection.rule: First qualifying candidate in fixed priority. At most one primary environment and one secondary behavior. If none qualifies, primary/secondary null; fixed first priority may be scored only as a clearly labelled retrospective exploratory diagnostic. Never choose based on model loss.
selection.new_seed_confirmation: Not automatic. Requires a qualified environmental target, a pre-outcome frozen separate confirmation plan and justified measurement coverage. No new simulation in archive audit or retrospective prediction. If no environmental target qualifies, STOP without new runs.

models.family: Existing v074 Hierarchy, min20, Dirichlet strength5, binary classes; M0=X,A, M1=X,A,B, M2=X,A,B,RD with M1 parent. Independent X-only reference for environmental target.
models.forbidden_features: Coordinates, exact resource quantities, patch geometry, future actions, outcomes, agent IDs, age/generation and future states are NOT predictor features
models.comparison: Same labels/decision keys for every head; M0/M1 common support and stricter all-head common support separate. Unsupported memory effects NA, not zero. Raw all-decision scores remain exploratory backoff diagnostics.
models.uncertainty: Ecological seed is replicate; mean/sampleSD,min,max,n; no significance tests; temporal/agent dependence acknowledged

stopping: One archive audit, one feasibility analysis, one frozen selection, one bounded retrospective comparison of at most two target definitions. No horizon/radius/threshold/model retuning, no ecological intervention. Negative or unavailable result acceptable.
